ABOUT FIELDWELL

A focused AI product.
A clearly defined buyer.

For commercial growers and agronomy teams. Fieldwell compares drone and scouting photos, marks signs of crop stress, and turns each survey into a field-by-field inspection report.

Illustrative operating context · licensed photography
THE BUSINESS IDEA

AI checks field photos and shows agronomists where to inspect next.

One drone survey can contain hundreds of overlapping images. The useful job is to compare new observations with the last survey and group repeated signs of stress into areas a field team can inspect.

Who buys it
Commercial growers & agronomy teams
What they send in
Drone surveys and scouting photos
What they receive
A crop-risk map and inspection list
How it is sold
A B2B subscription with a defined processing allowance.
OWNERSHIP & PRODUCT STATUS

Clear about the
business behind the page.

Fieldwell is an MVP product concept developed for Uniqkode. The website and review tools work; prepared case data demonstrates the intended AI workflow. A live model account and production identity service are not connected by default.

Customer endorsements, paid-user counts and company registration details have not been supplied. This website makes no claim that an unrelated company uses the product or that a registered legal entity operates it.
